what_changed: Added merge-on-write: session-owned fields (owner, attempts, retry_budget, blocked_evidence), session-set states, unknown keys and hand-added entries all survive a re-score; entry ids are assigned once per route and persisted instead of being positional.
why: PD-003 and PD-004 in receipt CYC-0001. Step 3 of every cycle ran --write, which regenerated the ledger from the graph and destroyed the loop's only memory on a four-hour cadence, and positional ids meant a receipt's entry id would later name a different route.
old_value: --write rebuilt all entries from systems/graph and wrote them over the existing file; ids were AUT-{sorted index + 1}.
new_value: merge(generated, existing) preserves session state and hand-added rows; ids are stable per route.
self_serving_check: NO, and the opposite. It makes the loop's own attempts and fruitless-attempt penalty actually accumulate, so routes the loop keeps failing at will DECAY in priority rather than resetting to a clean slate every cycle. It also makes blocked_evidence durable, which is what CLAUDE.md §0 requires before a block may stand.

what_changed: Added six guards for PD-003 and PD-004: a hand-added entry survives a re-score; a claim survives the next re-score; blocked_evidence is never discarded; an entry id is stable when the graph grows; a new route gets an unused id; and a mutation test that bypasses merge() and asserts the preservation actually breaks.
why: The fix for PD-003/PD-004 is worthless without guards — both defects were silent, and a silent defect that returns is indistinguishable from one that never left.
old_value: 8 tests covering the scorer's clamps only.
new_value: 14 tests; the six new ones cover ledger persistence and id stability.
self_serving_check: NO — every one of the six ADDS a constraint on the loop. None relaxes an assertion, none deletes a case, and the mutation test exists specifically to prove the new guards are not decorative. Declared because tests/** is a governed path and the guard correctly refused the commit until it was.

why: CYC-0001 established the top-scored item as blocked WITH evidence, and it still scored 195 and still sorted first — so the next cycle would have re-derived the identical block every four hours forever. The bonus promotes the harder, slower job (a hardening round and a blind seat) over the easy one (posting), which is the opposite of making success easier to report.
